summary: Library urges FCC to preserve E-Rate funding to maintain library services and avoid budget pressure

claims.argument: E-Rate helps ensure library has reliable internet connection, and losing funding would put additional pressure on budget and could delay technology upgrades
claims.evidence_quote: Without this funding, losing E-Rate funding would put additional pressure on our budget and could mean delaying technology upgrades or pulling funding away from programs and services our community relies on. As a public library, we need to keep our services accessible to everyone, and reliable internet is a huge part of that.
